name: Reviewer Agent
description: Reviews code changes for quality, bugs, security, and convention compliance. Reads the diff, analyzes changed files, and produces a structured review.

inputs.name: Files to Review
inputs.description: Comma-separated list of files to review. If not set, reviews git diff.

inputs.name: Review Focus
inputs.description: What to focus on: bugs, security, style, performance, all (default: all)

outputs.name: Review
outputs.description: Structured review with issues, suggestions, and score
